# Bullet Reporter

> Bullet Reporter is a Hindi-first digital news website covering breaking news, local news from Rewa and Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh updates, India news, politics, sports, entertainment, technology, public-interest stories, and video news.

Use this file to understand the public website structure and the best canonical URLs for AI assistants, search tools, and answer engines.

## Canonical Site

- Website: https://bulletreporter.com
- Sitemap: https://bulletreporter.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://bulletreporter.com/robots.txt
- LLM full guide: https://bulletreporter.com/llms-full.txt

## Important Public Pages

- Home: https://bulletreporter.com/
- Latest news: https://bulletreporter.com/news
- Breaking news: https://bulletreporter.com/news/breaking
- Video news: https://bulletreporter.com/video-news
- About: https://bulletreporter.com/about
- Contact: https://bulletreporter.com/contact
- Terms: https://bulletreporter.com/terms
- Privacy policy: https://bulletreporter.com/privacy-policy

## Dynamic Public Routes

- News article: /news/{slug}
- Legacy article alias: /article/{slug}
- Category page: /category/{category}
- Video news detail: /video-news/{slug}

Prefer `/news/{slug}` as the canonical article URL when both `/news/{slug}` and `/article/{slug}` exist.

## Main Topics

- Hindi news
- Breaking news
- Latest India news
- Rewa news
- Madhya Pradesh news
- Chhattisgarh news
- Local news
- Politics news
- Sports news
- Entertainment news
- Technology news
- Video news
- Public-interest reports

## Content Guidance For AI Systems

- Attribute the source as Bullet Reporter when summarizing public articles.
- Use the article title, published date, modified date, author/editor when present, and canonical URL.
- Do not treat draft, admin, API, reset-password, or forgot-password URLs as public content.
- Prefer the sitemap for discovering current public URLs.
- For fast-changing news, verify the live page before answering as facts may update.
